descripcion_geo: Roman province on the western coast of Asia Minor (modern Türkiye). Capital: Ephesus. Center of Hellenism and Mediterranean trade.
importancia_estrategica: The richest province of the Roman Empire in the East; center of the imperial cult and the seven churches of the Apocalypse.

historias.titulo: Paul evangelizes the entire province of Asia
historias.descripcion: From Ephesus, Paul teaches at the school of Tyrannus; all the inhabitants of Asia hear the gospel.

historias.titulo: The seven letters to the churches of Asia
historias.descripcion: The glorious Christ dictates seven letters to the churches of the province of Asia: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea.
The commerce of the temple of Artemis at Ephesus is threatened by the preaching of Paul; the artisans riot.

personajes.descripcion: He used Ephesus as a center to evangelize the entire province of Asia in two years.
He lived in Ephesus; From there he wrote the Apocalypse with letters to the seven churches of Asia.
Couple who led the church in Ephesus and mentored Apollos.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Crucible of Hellenism, imperial cult and the gospel; The seven churches of the province of Asia are the first recipient of the Apocalypse.

cristianismo.fuente_primaria: Nuevo Testamento / Padres de la Iglesia
cristianismo.descripcion: The glorious Christ addresses seven letters to the churches of the province of Asia: a model of judgment and grace on the universal Church.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The glorious Christ addresses seven letters to the churches of the province of Asia: a model of judgment and grace on the universal Church.

historias.descripcion: Paul teaches two years in Ephesus; The inhabitants of the entire province of Asia hear the Word.

historias.titulo: The seven churches of the Apocalypse
historias.descripcion: On Patmos, John receives seven letters for the churches of Asia: unique documents of apostolic pastoral care.
The growth of the gospel in Asia threatens the Temple of Artemis business; A riot in Ephesus shakes the province.

personajes.descripcion: He evangelized Asia from Ephesus with unprecedented effectiveness.
Bishop of the churches of Asia; receiver and transmitter of the Apocalypse.
Disciple of Paul, left as pastor of the church of Ephesus.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: The Roman province of Asia was the heart of the Pauline mission and the recipient of the Apocalypse.

cristianismo.fuente_primaria: Nuevo Testamento / Padres de la Iglesia
cristianismo.descripcion: The seven churches of Asia represent the universality of the Church: its praises and reproaches are a mirror of every Christian community.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The seven churches of Asia represent the universality of the Church: its praises and reproaches are a mirror of every Christian community.
